summary: An Ilford solicitors firm appears to lose enquiries to leftover template instructions, awkward copy and a free builder address.

findings.problem: The text Let your visitors know how you would like stay in touch appears on the page, which looks like a template instruction.
findings.cost: Template instructions on a law firm page make the firm look unfinished.

findings.problem: The page title appears to begin with a lowercase kayani and read A Firm Solicitors, and the heading appears as A Firm Of Solicitor.
findings.cost: Naming errors in the firm's own title weaken trust.

findings.problem: Copy such as You explore areas of law on the website we outclass others appears on the page.
findings.cost: Garbled sentences make clients doubt a firm's attention to detail.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Weebly address, and no WhatsApp appears.
findings.cost: A free builder address looks temporary and clients cannot message quickly.
